Country.evidence_source: This screening resulted in a final data set of 382 participants (192 women and 190 men) from 45 U.S. states.

Sample.evidence_source: This screening resulted in a final data set of 382 participants (192 women and 190 men) from 45 U.S. states.

Survey method.evidence_source: If interested, they signed up via the MTurk worker hit website, provided their consent, and completed the survey via SurveyMonkey.

Percent of white in participants.evidence_source: Participants identified as White (71.9%), African American (8.4%), Asian American (9.2%), Latina/Latino (6.3%), Native American (0.5%), or multiracial (3.6%).

Mean age of participants.evidence_source: They ranged in age from 18 to 75 (M_{\rm age}=33.38, SD=11.08).

Percentage of college or higher of parti.evidence_source: One (0.3%) did not complete high school, 13.6% finished high school, and the remaining participants (86.1%) reported at least a year of college education.

Mean BMI of participants.evidence_source: Average BMI was 26.82 (SD=7.30) for women and 26.54 (SD=5.96) for men.

Source of sample.evidence_source: Community participants who were from the U.S., completed at least 100 hits, and had their previous work approved at least 98% of the time were introduced to this study as "an investigation of attitudes about food, eating, and body." If interested, they signed up via the MTurk worker hit website, provided their consent, and completed the survey via SurveyMonkey.

Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The 10-item BAS-2 with the modified Item 8 example was analyzed (see Appendix).

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Participants self-reported their height and weight, which were used to calculate BMI.

Number of studies.evidence_source: Participants were deleted from the data set if they had participated in Study 2 (n=1), failed the validity question embedded between BAS-2 Items 9 and 10 (n=7), terminated early (n=11), or had significant missing data (n=8).

section_summary.extract_value: This Methods section describes an online MTurk community sample (final N=382; 192 women, 190 men) from 45 U.S. states who completed a SurveyMonkey survey including the 10-item BAS-2; BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight. Demographics: mean age 33.38 (SD=11.08), 71.9% White, and 86.1% reported at least a year of college; the text also references 'Study 2', indicating multiple studies in the paper.
